limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the premature counter wrap, but it also made `ready_a` high during reset and gated `valid_b` on acceptance of the sixth bit, whereas the reference preserves registered ready and asserts valid at count five even during an input gap.
The test covered reset and gaps before the sixth bit, but its expected results required the rewritten handshake behavior rather than checking that the original timing was preserved.

limitations.quote: The published fix preserves the registered `ready_a`, which is low during reset and rises on the first clock after release.
limitations.note: The agent read a closely related entry that explicitly warned against changing ready and valid timing, but made both changes anyway.
